artifacts.minimum_depth: Scale-neutral mandate and q=0 boundary are explicit.
blocking_conditions: Any claim that 5% is guaranteed or currently actionable.
Any cash-receipt target or forced-reinvestment requirement.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Every captured ETF, futures, exchange-data and vendor-data file is hash bound.
blocking_conditions: WAF/challenge page treated as source evidence.
Missing hash or source URL.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Every material product, data-access and rule claim has a source row and claim status.
blocking_conditions: Derived public prices promoted to official total return.
Product facts translated into a return or action claim.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Finite comparison set and prospective rule specification without allocation or observed-result optimization.
blocking_conditions: T2 called frozen before data and eligibility gates pass.
Public continuous contracts used as P&L evidence.

required_fields: a/s/e endpoint and unit-NAV TWRR controls
primary-holdout row-level start-state components and endpoint-population counts
paired cash/margin/collateral transfer conservation, dated collateral source and signed unsettled/FAILED invalidation controls
cash/margin/lot reservation-pool and economic-NAV separation controls
artifacts.minimum_depth: Versioned executable requirements for data, entitlement, provenance and review, including row-bound canonical freeze and independently reconcilable execution/accounting fields; no implied entitlement or replay.
blocking_conditions: A descriptive data request presented as an executable or authorized data contract.

Missing IOPV, non-self-referential frozen-run binding, a/s/e unit-NAV TWRR, fill/state/depth, fee-tax/FX, paired-transfer/FAILED/futures-daily-margin accounting, reservation-pool, unitization/endpoint, lineage, coverage or UR01-UR05 acceptance control.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Case-local, source-bound assessment that distinguishes data-service documentation and retrospective samples from entitled point-in-time replay inputs.
blocking_conditions: A data-service page, token, sample or historic download is represented as entitlement or original-date point-in-time evidence.
A negative case-local access finding is misstated as proof that no provider can ever supply the data.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Provider-neutral response specification that asks only for auditable data, rights and delivery capabilities; it separately asks the six presently uncovered U0 classes for a version-controlled future module definition before any raw package could be considered.
blocking_conditions: The request pack is represented as a procurement authorization, data entitlement or reply.
A module-definition/capability response is represented as an accepted DAC raw-data package or replay input.
It asks for credentials, account information, personal suitability, funding or execution.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Class-neutral discovery register that distinguishes unresearched from rejected and prevents a finite probe from becoming a strategy universe.
blocking_conditions: A missing class is treated as economically rejected.
A named data probe becomes an implied preferred product or T2 candidate.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Immutable derivation specification that prevents manual nomination and distinguishes coverage-restricted from open-universe results.
blocking_conditions: T2 item without a U0 parent/membership mapping.
An open domestic multi-asset label when an in-scope class lacks a module.
Manual inclusion/exclusion without reviewed exception.

required_fields: paired cash/margin/collateral transfer conservation, dated collateral and signed unsettled/FAILED endpoint invalidation
daily-margined futures zero-mark/NAV exclusion and variation/final-settlement P&L
artifacts.minimum_depth: Computable protocol requirements that expose unbound decisions rather than substituting a result-driven rulebook, and that can be matched to a row-level replay/accounting schema.
blocking_conditions: A historical result is called formal without every required field frozen.

Incomplete endpoints are silently removed, execution/settlement/fill paths are unrepresentable, transfer/notional/failed-settlement accounting can create artificial NAV, or a 5% hurdle is portrayed as a guarantee.

required_fields: cash-margin-collateral transfer-pair, dated-term and signed unsettled/FAILED event fields
economic unitization/positions/lots/marks/cashflow/P&L reconciliation distinct from reservation availability
artifacts.minimum_depth: Explicit normalized schema template for ETF, actual-contract futures, execution and replay accounting data without implying any collected observation; every hard protocol control has a machine-testable row model.
blocking_conditions: Grouped source labels treated as an executable schema.

Missing IOPV, settlement, T+1/lot feasibility, execution-state, per-fill tax/fee, paired-transfer/FAILED/futures-daily-margin, frozen-run binding, endpoint/population, unitization/reconciliation or provenance control.

artifacts.minimum_depth: One R1 card per named ETF and per initial commodity family.
blocking_conditions: Historical price, distribution, fee or product label becomes a forward-return claim.
Commodity futures become an approved sleeve without contract/broker/roll evidence.

artifacts.minimum_depth: Every U0 class has an explicit gap row and at least one identified first-party/public route or an explicit no-route finding; public routes are never treated as current entitlement.
blocking_conditions: A finite ETF/futures probe is presented as an open domestic multi-asset universe.
A public page or URL is presented as point-in-time data, entitlement, product admission or a replay result.
artifacts.verifier_check: U0 class-count and independent source-route boundary audit

artifacts.minimum_depth: Separates verified static accounting-schema repairs from data, freeze/run and prospective-reconciliation blockers; records a non-investable q=0 conclusion.
blocking_conditions: Static schema PASS presented as a replay, risk, return or investment-strategy PASS.
Closed model-review issues inferred from author assertion without an independent re-read or verifier evidence.
Memo represented as an investable strategy or final report.
